motion: The camera does not move. The hundred stand still on the crest, staring down at the long black building in the valley, the wind pulling at their coats. The old man in the foreground stays on his feet, bent over his walking stick, catching his breath, his shoulders rising and falling, while the younger man keeps a steadying hand on his back. The spilled blankets by the tipped trolley stir in the wind. The small grey robot's amber beacon pulses slowly. Along the building, the thin amber seam brightens slowly from end to end. Every person keeps their shape. The camera does not move.
